instruction: Move my design review tomorrow to 2pm.
final_text:
I moved tomorrow's (Wed 30 Sep) design review from 11:00–12:00 to 2:00–3:00pm. It's still an hour long. Rachel and Jordan have been notified of the change.

It doesn't clash with anything on your calendar, and your 3:30 1:1 with Jordan is still free. I can't see Rachel's or Jordan's calendars, so I don't know yet whether 2pm works for them. Their earlier acceptances were for the 11am time.
